description:
Russell Brand sits down with Sean Stone to revisit one of the most surreal moments of his career — the time he found himself on the New York set of Wall Street 2 with director Oliver Stone and came face to face with Donald Trump. Russell performed some stand up material and took a jab at Trump sparking a tense back and forth between the two before Oliver Stone stepped in furious and forced Russell to write a formal apology letter. Russell reflects on how the whole experience took him straight back to his childhood where writing apology letters was practically a weekly occurrence. A brilliantly funny and deeply revealing story about Russell's most unexpected Hollywood encounter.
